$comment: What this repository contributes to a running stack, and what a check may
believe about it. Everything under `checked` is proved against this
repository by internal/manifest, by building and running the binary.
Everything under `declared` is a statement nobody can verify and carries
distribution: published as ghcr.io/taipanbox/keyryx: v0.1.0 (2026-10-18), v0.1.1 (2026-10-19) and v0.1.2 (2026-10-19, the latest), by .github/workflows/release.yml on each v* tag push, for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, with an SBOM and a build-provenance attestation attached. v0.1.1 and v0.1.2 carry a cosign signature in the legacy cosign format; v0.1.0 carries none

role.value: key custody and an independent witness for the agent-governance record, off every request path
role.why: a sentence about purpose is not a property of the source

roles_separate.value: custody and witness are two processes of one binary, never one: the witness refuses KEYRYX_DATA or KEYRYX_ROOT_KEY_FILE as its own, or a copy of custody's root key
roles_separate.why: the uid and the volume each runs under are the launcher's to set; this repository can refuse sharing a path or a key, not choose a uid

witness_conditional.value: KEYRYX_WITNESS_CUSTODY_URL and KEYRYX_WITNESS_STREAM_KEYS are required once KEYRYX_WITNESS_CHECKPOINTS is set, and KEYRYX_WITNESS_TSA_CA once KEYRYX_WITNESS_TSA_URL is
witness_conditional.why: the manifest's required/optional split cannot express a variable required only by another one; internal/wconfig holds the conditional rule and its tests

tsa_opt_in.value: unset: no time-stamping authority is called; the witness log is anchored on this host only
tsa_opt_in.why: an RFC 3161 authority is an outbound call to a third party, opt-in by the operator; without one the witness defends against the planes, not against root on the host

socket_dir_conditional.value: KEYRYX_SOCKET_DIR is required once a consumer in KEYRYX_POLICY authenticates by socket, and KEYRYX_K8S_ISSUERS once one authenticates by a projected service-account token
socket_dir_conditional.why: the manifest's required/optional split cannot express a variable required only by what another one says; internal/config holds the conditional rule and its tests

admin_keys_default.value: unset: rotate and revoke refuse every call (403)
admin_keys_default.why: optional because a deployment may rotate by restarting with a new policy; fail closed when unset, never open
